plugins.name: Codex imagegen skill
plugins.notes: Use for text-to-image and reference-guided bitmap concepts before mapping the result to WinCC-native objects.

plugins.name: Siemens TIA Portal Openness
plugins.notes: Primary engineering-time route for screens, tags, alarms, faceplates, scripts and compile workflows when the installed API exposes the required objects.

plugins.name: SiVArc Openness
plugins.notes: Use for repeated station/device screen generation only when the local SiVArc API and license are present.

plugins.name: TIA Portal Openness MCP
plugins.versions: V20-V21 Unified; community forks add V18 Classic/Comfort
plugins.notes: Useful for declarative PLC/HMI generation. Prefer source review and a project clone before enabling its executable.

plugins.name: TIA V20 Unified MCP
plugins.notes: Useful as a reference for PLC/HMI MCP workflows around project creation, XML analysis, compile diagnostics and rollback. Treat as source pattern until reviewed locally.

plugins.name: TIA Openness Manager
plugins.notes: Community tool pattern, now presented as AnyAutomation Studio, for bulk export/import, HMI assets, dead-code style review and AI-assisted workflows. Do not execute against customer projects before code, license and backup behavior are reviewed.

plugins.name: TIA Add-In ShowScripts
plugins.notes: Exports WinCC Unified screen JavaScript and an overview for review. It is not a general screen writer.

plugins.name: WinCC Unified MCP Server
plugins.notes: Use for runtime tag/alarm browsing and validation. Do not expose it beyond a trusted network and do not disable TLS validation in production.

plugins.name: CWC in WinCC Unified
plugins.notes: Use as a design and packaging reference when standard controls or faceplates cannot meet the requirement.

plugins.name: WinCC Unified community CWC libraries
plugins.notes: Review license, code and dependency provenance before copying a component into a customer project.

plugins.name: TiaImportExport.VSExt
plugins.notes: Useful source reference for TIA export/import, SIMATIC SD style editing and preview workflows. Do not install or execute binaries on customer projects until source, license and clone behavior are reviewed.

plugins.name: TIA Viewer / ImportExport style tools
plugins.notes: Useful design pattern for rendering SimaticML, SCL, DB, UDT, LAD/FBD and GRAPH exports into a workbench preview. Treat as a viewer/import-export reference, not as a trusted writer until reviewed.
